title: An applied set of declarations
description: What PUT /api/v1/declarations answers once the set is in force. A set holding an invalid declaration answers 422 with code invalid_declarations and an invalid list instead, naming each declaration and its problems, and the set in force stays as it was.

applied_by.description: The login that applied the set in force.

unchanged.description: True where this commit's set was already in force, so nothing was written.
